newsitem.title: DENMARK: BG Bank rises on outperform recommendation.
newsitem.headline: BG Bank rises on outperform recommendation.

text.p: Third biggest Danish bank BG Bank shares were up 4.8 percent on Thursday after Den Danske Bank said it maintained its 'outperform' recommendation for the stock.
The BG Bank share had risen 16 crowns to 350 at 1300 GMT.
On June 13, BG Bank, insurer Topdanmark and leading mortgage credit institution Nykredit ended a strategic alliance.
In recent days rumours of a possible BG Bank merger with foreign or local banks have circulated in the market. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
